programme.title: Daring Gundaraaj
programme.desc: Jagan falls for Sunanda, who happens to be the daughter of his father's business rival. Further hilarity ensues when the two tycoons unknowingly broker a match between their love-struck children.

programme.title: Aatma Ka Ghar
programme.desc: A series of ominous events unfurl when a newly married couple move into a house haunted by a voyeuristic spirit that soon becomes fixated on the wife.

programme.title: Aatma Ka Ghar 2
programme.desc: Mohini and Harsha relocate to a different city to escape the haunting of an evil spirit only to later realize that the spirit is still hot on their trail.

programme.title: Madhagaja
programme.desc: The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.

programme.title: Mirai
programme.desc: When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.

programme.title: Big Brother
programme.desc: Sachi dreams of a tranquil life with his family after serving his time in prison. However, fate has other plans for the ex-convict when he encounters a dangerous drug lord.

programme.title: Stalin
programme.desc: Stalin, a former army officer, is deeply moved by the suicide of a girl with physical disabilities. So, he devises a plan to extend unconditional help to those who need it to establish peace.

programme.title: Chaalis Chauraasi
programme.desc: Four friends hatch a scheme to steal money by impersonating the police. However, on their way, they run into a real inspector who enlists them to carry out an encounter.

programme.title: Warning
programme.desc: A group of friends go for a yacht ride to celebrate their friend's birthday. However, the party turns into a misadventure when they decide to go swimming, and they encounter a dangerous predator.

programme.title: Pankh
programme.desc: A young boy, dressed as a girl for a film, becomes famous. However, he struggles to break free from his breakout role after growing up, leading him to live a troubled life.

programme.title: Karthikeya Mahima
programme.desc: An anthology of stories wherein ardent devotees of Kartikeya, the Hindu god of war, overcome various obstacles and succeed in their lives with the Almighty's help.

programme.title: Hanuman Da' Damdaar
programme.desc: A young boy, sets out to make his father proud by embarking on a series of jungle adventure which leads him to metamorphose in to Hanuman.

programme.title: Jaguar

programme.title: Bholaa Shankar
programme.desc: A cab driver in Calcutta struggles to rebuild his life with his sister while confronting a haunting past. Subsequently, he fights to protect his future and family from the city's gritty underworld.

programme.title: The Warriorr

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
programme.desc: A single mother and her two children move into a farmhouse inherited from her estranged father. As they settle in, they discover their associations with Ghostbusters.

programme.title: Sound of Metal
programme.desc: Ruben, a drummer, is distraught when he begins losing his hearing. However, things take a turn when he meets Joe, who heads a community comprising people with hearing impairment.

programme.title: The Cable Guy
programme.desc: Chip, a cable technician, sets his sights on befriending Steven, a new customer whom he takes a fancy to. But when Steven spurns their friendship, Chip immediately starts to wreak havoc in his life.

programme.title: Daddio
programme.desc: A woman takes a cab ride back home from the airport. En route, she unexpectedly has an insightful conversation with the driver regarding the important relationships in life.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Count Dracula is overjoyed to witness the birth of his grandson, Dennis. However, when Dennis shows no signs of being a vampire, Dracula tries to help him unlock his powers.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: When Peter Venkman, Raymond Stantz and Egon Spengler lose their jobs as scientists, they start an establishment called Ghostbusters to fight the evil ghosts lurking in New York City.

programme.title: The Walk
programme.desc: Philippe Petit, a French street performer, dreams of performing daring stunts. He attempts to walk between the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center in New York on a tightrope.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: After a night of revelry, four friends accidentally run over a man and dump his body to conceal their secret, unaware that the following year brings a series of eerie events in their lives.

programme.title: Monster Hunter
programme.desc: Captain Artemis and her group of soldiers are pulled into a world where dangerous monsters and humans co-exist. Grappled by danger, they must find a way to escape with help from a mysterious hunter.

programme.title: Morbius
programme.desc: Determined to cure the disease that has plagued him his entire life, Morbius conducts a drastic experiment, which bears unforeseen consequences.

programme.title: The Pope's Exorcist
programme.desc: Father Gabriele Amorth, an exorcist, uncovers a hidden conspiracy as he investigates the horrifying possession of a young boy.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: A documentary crew, who are on a mission to find a tribe named Shirishamas, helps a snake hunter when they find him stranded. However, he forces them to risk their lives and hunt down an anaconda.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong, a mischievous young boy, learns a special form of martial arts from his alcoholic master in order to prevent an assassin from executing his goals.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: As astronauts discover the first evidence of extra-terrestrial life on Mars, they begin realising that the life form is extremely intelligent and hostile.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
